segments.name: Personal Lending
segments.description: Upstart's AI lending marketplace segment originating unsecured personal and small dollar loans for consumers, funded by lending partners and institutional investors.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that only one operating segment, Personal Lending, meets the definition of a reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Upstart earns fees from lending partners and institutional investors for use of its platform, borrower referrals, and loan servicing.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue consists primarily of fees paid by lending partners and institutional investors.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company reclassified auto secured personal loans from the Personal Lending operating segment to the Auto Lending operating segment.
changes.evidence: Beginning in the third quarter of 2025, the Company reclassified auto secured personal loans from Personal Lending to Auto Lending operating segment.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company suspended development of its small business loan product as part of a reorganization plan.
changes.evidence: As part of the January 2023 Plan, the Company reduced its workforce by approximately 20 %, or 365 employees, and suspended development of its small business loan product.
